QuotedData's In The HotSeat - Craig Baker of Alliance Witan

On 18 September 2026 at 11am, the team will be talking through the weekly news from the world of investment companies and interview Craig Baker as this week's special guest - Click here to watch live and ask questions, or for the recording after the event.

The best way to enjoy the show is to join our weekly webinar live, at 11 am every Friday, where we discuss the key stories and events in the investment companies' sector over the last week. We also invite a guest every week and give you the opportunity to get answers to your questions.
